newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly to take $4.40/shr charge in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly to take $4.40/shr charge in Q2.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co said Monday it would take a one-time, noncash charge of $4.40 per share in the second quarter to write down the carrying value of its PCS health-care-management businesses.

The company said the adjustment, worth about $2.4 billion, was necessary because it now estimates the projected undiscounted cash flows for the PCS division will fall below the previous carrying value.
The company said the charge will have no impact on the operations of PCS.
